setting.help: Day of the month (1-28) on which the single AMC scheduled action (AMC: Monthly Milestones & Timesheets, which also creates the current month's milestones on the 1st) sends everything for the previous month at the same time: the AMC timesheet / task reports of the months without a payment milestone, and the AMC payment milestones that are still Not Started (send switch on), which are marked Completed, get their task Excel attached and are e-mailed to the customer. Default: 7. Later daily runs catch up a missed day and retry failures.

xpath.attribute: First day of the first month to report, e.g. 2026-10-01 means October 2026 is the first month e-mailed, on the Monthly E-mail Day of November 2026. Earlier months are never sent automatically. Leave empty for no limit.
